summary: Netflix's main friction themes include content quality and variety, pricing and value, account sharing and accessibility, and user experience and app functionality.

themes.name: Content Quality and Variety
themes.description: Users express frustration with declining content quality, poor show pacing, and lack of diverse genres like horror. Some criticize specific shows for being unoriginal or poorly executed, while others request more niche content like horror movies or specific series (e.g., Minecraft, One Piece).
themes.recommendation: Invest in original content, improve show pacing, and expand genre offerings.

quotes.text: Netflix Viewers Are Abandoning Shows After One Season. submitted by /u/joe4942 to r/technology

He never complained about the quality of television shows, just about television. And I concur. The quality of television has gone down a lot. Too many ads, too many channels filled with rubbish. I stopped watching too, and turned to Netflix instead.
"Building something cool in minecraft is pretty different from watching spongebob on netflix." Is it? Why is watching and thinking about something less valuable than "building" something?

themes.name: Pricing and Value
themes.description: Users are frustrated with rising subscription costs and feel they are not getting enough value for the price, especially when compared to piracy or other streaming services. Some users also complain about the cost of specific content (e.g., movies) not being available on the platform.
themes.recommendation: Reevaluate pricing strategy and offer more value through content or bundling.

themes.name: User Experience and App Functionality
themes.description: Users praise the app for being intuitive and having a vast library of content, but some complain about technical issues like signing out unexpectedly, poor app performance on older devices, and the lack of features like full-season availability.
themes.recommendation: Optimize app performance, improve device compatibility, and enhance user control over content access.

themes.name: Account Sharing and Accessibility
themes.description: Users are concerned about account sharing and the lack of control over who can access their content. Some users also mention the inconvenience of not being able to watch content on older devices or the inability to watch entire seasons at once.
themes.recommendation: Implement stricter account management and improve device compatibility.
